task.title: Audit the checkout page for what axe cannot see
task.description: The help dialog traps Tab, the Pay button has no visible focus and its hover state has a low contrast.
criteria: The checkout page is keyboard accessible
Focus and hover states are visible

testCases.title: Open and close the help dialog
testCases.approach: the checkout page is open, the user opens the help dialog with the keyboard and tries to leave it with Tab and Escape, focus can leave the dialog and returns to the Help button
testCases.when: the user opens the help dialog with the keyboard and tries to leave it with Tab and Escape
testCases.then: focus can leave the dialog and returns to the Help button

testCases.title: Pay button hover and focus
testCases.approach: the checkout page is open, the user hovers the Pay button and tabs to it, the hover and focus states are visible and readable
testCases.when: the user hovers the Pay button and tabs to it
testCases.then: the hover and focus states are visible and readable
